objective: Remove packaged per-role sandbox overrides so all native roles inherit the explicitly selected session policy

acceptance.text: All bundled native roles inherit the effective session sandbox policy, with no default role-level sandbox override; launcher unsandboxed default and explicit sandbox opt-in remain unchanged.
Read-only reviewer/researcher/explorer responsibilities and separation of duties remain behavioral instructions, while installed setup preserves existing user role and global configuration.
Installed-copy regression and package validation reject reintroduced default role sandbox overrides without calling real model services or changing user configuration.
